name: A Number Takes Root
description: Plant a correct number without using a hint.

name: Nine in Line
description: Complete a row, column, or box with a placement of your own.

name: Growing Stronger
description: Upgrade a tower.

name: Added Potential
description: Equip a module on a tower.

name: Recovered Supplies
description: Open a chest with fragments.

name: Timely Intervention
description: Use a combat boost during a wave.

name: Holding the Line
description: Clear a wave.

name: Giant Answer
description: Defeat a boss before it reaches the core.

name: Double Digits
description: Clear round 10 in Campaign or Locked In.

name: Halfway Home
description: Clear round 25 in Campaign or Locked In.

name: Fifty and Standing
description: Clear all 50 rounds in Campaign or Locked In.

name: A Promise Kept
description: Clear all 50 rounds in Locked In.

name: Family Investment
description: Upgrade a number family.

name: Strength in Numbers
description: Raise a number family to level 5.

name: A Tower of Your Own
description: Raise one tower's individual level to 5.

name: Fully Fitted
description: Fill all five module sockets on one tower.

name: Double Down
description: Equip two modules of the same kind on one tower.

name: Combined Arms
description: Equip three different module kinds on one tower.

name: Different Priorities
description: Clear a wave with legal towers using all three target priorities.

name: Every Number Counts
description: Clear a wave with a legal tower of every number from 1 to 9.

name: Hard Answers
description: Complete a Hard Sudoku grid.

name: Your Own Reasoning
description: Complete a Sudoku grid without using a hint on that grid.

name: Nothing Gets Through
description: Clear a boss wave without any enemies reaching the core.

name: Controlled Chaos
description: Clear a wave after planting at least three illegal emergency towers in it.

name: Enough to Defend
description: Clear a wave with the Sudoku grid still incomplete.

name: By the Rules
description: Clear all 50 rounds in Campaign or Locked In without planting an illegal emergency tower.
